headline: IT held the Nifty up while *the broader market bled*
subline: IT rose 2.88%, but 2,338 stocks fell against 337 that rose.
hero_text: Nifty Smallcap 250 fell 2.26% and Midcap 150 fell 1.39%. Fear rose, with India VIX up 6.11% to 15.68.
why_head: Why IT could not lift Nifty

why.title: Wall Street rose, Asia slipped
why.desc: US and Europe closed higher while Asia lagged and India stayed lower.

why.title: IT stocks cushioned the index
why.desc: Infosys, HCLTech and TechM each rose more than 3 percent.

why.title: Smallcaps took the brunt
why.desc: Midcap 150 fell 1.39 percent. Declines outnumbered advances 2,338 to 337.

why.title: Fear gauge jumped higher
why.desc: India VIX closed at 15.68, the top of its 20 session range.

sector_reasons.IT: Led as Infosys and HCLTech rose over 3 percent
sector_reasons.Oil & Gas: Nearly flat, a steady spot as others fell
sector_reasons.Pharma: Slipped little as defensive names held on
sector_reasons.Consumer Durables: Discretionary names fell hardest of the six
sector_reasons.Metal: Cyclical names sagged with the broader tape
sector_reasons.Auto: Eicher Motors fell 2.43 percent and pulled it lower

bonus_text: India VIX rose 6.11% to 15.68, the top of its 20 session range. Fear built while the index barely moved.
movers_note_gainers: Four IT names led the board. Infosys topped it.
movers_note_losers: Bajaj Finance led the slide, with BSE, Eternal and Eicher close behind.
watch_text: Thursday: 23,000 holds peak call OI and 22,000 peak put OI. Nifty PCR sits at 0.70.
lessons: One sector held the index up. IT rose while 34 of 50 Nifty names fell.
The broader market took the hit. Smallcaps fell far harder than the frontline.
Institutions bought in cash, yet 52 week lows outnumbered highs, 285 to 25.
Fear built under a calm headline. The index lost little but the VIX hit a 20 session high.
alert_text: US jobless claims land at 22:00 IST on Thursday. Forecast is 200K against 199K prior.
cta_headline: A split day. *Save it for Thursday*.
cta_sub: Thursday's open arrives with fear at a 20 session high.
next_text: Thursday 22 October is the next session. The Nifty weekly expiry falls on Tuesday 27 October.
caption_a:
Nifty lost just 0.34% to 22,811, but 2,338 stocks fell against 337 that rose.
Nifty IT jumped 2.88% and masked a 2.26% slide in Smallcap 250.
India VIX rose 6.11% to 15.68.
Watch: US jobless claims at 22:00 IST on Thursday.
